Detailed Description

Class Representing Ascii Table Extensions. Contains columns with scalar row entries.

AsciiTable (re)implements functions prescribed in the Table abstract class. The implementations allow the calling of cfitsio specialized routines for AsciiTable header construction.

All of the constructors are protected to disallow direct instantiation. Instantiation of the concrete HDU types must be done through an HDUCreator factory instance. This disallows the creation of 'orphaned' HDU objects since the HDUCreator class requires a fitsfile pointer.

The read data methods are reimplemented by simplifying the more general BinTable versions that are implemented in that class.
